routes.title: OpenAI API key
routes.auth_flow: OPENAI_API_KEY is sent only to https://api.openai.com; a custom endpoint needs its own named connection key.
routes.models: GET /models can list models. Model-specific parameters and tool support can vary; Hutch has no live model capability probe.
routes.streaming: SSE is requested with stream_options.include_usage. An interrupted stream may omit final usage, so missing usage is not zero.
routes.tool_calls: Function-tool request and response framing is fixture-tested. Whether a particular model can use tools is not established by the endpoint alone.
routes.structured_output: Not sent by the current Hutch Chat Completions adapter.
routes.vision: Not exposed by the current Hutch chat UI/runtime path.
routes.context_limits: Model-specific. Hutch does not send a context-window override on this API.
routes.cancellation: Stop closes the response connection. The provider may already have processed or billed the request; uncertain usage stays reserved for reconciliation.
routes.usage_reporting: Prompt, completion and cached-token counts are recorded when returned. Interrupted streams may omit their final usage chunk.
routes.quota_reporting: Provider account quota and reset time are not queried.
routes.retention: Provider account and API data controls apply. Hutch does not claim zero retention for this route.
routes.verification: Recorded HTTP fixtures cover body shape, streaming, tool-call assembly, usage and provider errors; no live OpenAI request was made.

routes.title: Anthropic API key
routes.auth_flow: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is sent only to https://api.anthropic.com; a custom endpoint needs its own named connection key.
routes.models: Model ids are selected explicitly. The Anthropic API has no common model-list operation in Hutch's connection contract.
routes.streaming: Anthropic Messages streaming is used through the official SDK with its internal retries disabled.
routes.tool_calls: Tool-use request/response conversion and merged parallel tool results are fixture-tested. Model-level tool reliability remains unverified.
routes.structured_output: Not sent by the current Hutch Anthropic adapter.
routes.vision: Not exposed by the current Hutch chat UI/runtime path.
routes.context_limits: Model-specific. Hutch does not send a context-window override.
routes.cancellation: Stop closes the active response. If a request outcome cannot be verified, its usage reservation remains held.
routes.usage_reporting: Input, output, cache-read and cache-write counts are recorded when returned.
routes.quota_reporting: Provider account quota and reset time are not queried.
routes.retention: Provider account and API data controls apply. Hutch does not claim zero retention for this route.
routes.verification: Recorded SDK/HTTP fixtures cover request shape, streaming, tool-use conversion, usage, refusal and typed failures; no live Anthropic request was made.

routes.title: Ollama local API
routes.auth_flow: No key is sent to the default loopback service. A custom endpoint requires explicit connection configuration.
routes.models: The local server reports installed models and per-model metadata. Cloud-tagged model names are classified as hosted, not local.
routes.streaming: Newline-delimited JSON streams are consumed through the done record.
routes.tool_calls: Native tool-call framing and streamed response aggregation are fixture-tested; per-model reliability still needs a local model probe.
routes.structured_output: Not sent by Hutch's current request builder.
routes.vision: Not exposed by the current Hutch chat UI/runtime path.
routes.context_limits: Hutch requires and sends num_ctx explicitly. Runtime-reported truncation is surfaced; fit and memory admission remain estimates.
routes.cancellation: Stop closes the active HTTP response. Local server teardown and inference-process state are not certified by this provider contract.
routes.usage_reporting: Prompt/evaluation token counts and runtime timings are recorded from completed responses.
routes.quota_reporting: No provider quota applies to local models. Ollama Cloud quota is not queried by Hutch.
routes.retention: Local service storage and any proxying are controlled by that service. Local route mode does not guarantee offline operation.

sent: think when the model reports thinking capability

routes.verification: Recorded local HTTP fixtures cover request shape, context sizing, streaming, tools, usage and failure paths; Ollama was not installed for a live model check.

routes.title: OpenAI-compatible connection
routes.auth_flow: Each named connection owns its endpoint and key. The ambient OpenAI key is never sent to a custom host.
routes.models: A model-list request is used when the configured endpoint provides one; model capabilities are endpoint/model-specific and remain unknown without a verified probe.
routes.streaming: SSE is requested with include_usage. Hutch retries once without streaming when a compatible endpoint rejects stream options; live charge behavior is provider-specific.
routes.tool_calls: Function-tool framing is tested against a scripted endpoint. Compatibility does not prove that every server or model parses tools correctly.
routes.structured_output: Not sent by the current adapter.
routes.vision: Not exposed by the current Hutch chat UI/runtime path.
routes.context_limits: No context-window override is sent. The provider/model may use different defaults or limits.
routes.cancellation: Stop closes the response connection. The endpoint may continue work; unknown charges remain reserved until reconciliation.
routes.usage_reporting: Reported usage is recorded. Endpoint-specific omissions are not treated as zero.
routes.quota_reporting: Only operator-declared connection allowances are enforced; provider quotas and reset times are not queried.
routes.retention: The configured endpoint controls processing and retention. Review its terms before sending data.
routes.verification: Scripted HTTP contract tests exercise the common Chat Completions shape; each real endpoint still needs an operator connection check and capability verification.

routes.title: OpenCode Go API-key plan
routes.harness: Hutch builtin runtime through a named connection
routes.auth_flow: The user signs in to OpenCode Go, copies its issued provider API key, then stores that key in Hutch or supplies it via the named connection's environment variable. Hutch does not read OpenCode auth.json or browser sessions; it sends its own User-Agent and a stable per-conversation session header (or the run id for standalone work).
routes.models: Model list is endpoint-provided. Usage eligibility for general or unattended workloads is not established by Hutch.
routes.streaming: OpenAI-compatible streaming is requested; no live plan request was made.
routes.tool_calls: Common framing is fixture-tested, but no live model/plan tool-call check was made.
routes.structured_output: Not verified; not sent by Hutch.
routes.vision: Not verified; not exposed by Hutch.
routes.context_limits: Model-specific and not reported through the connection model list.
routes.cancellation: Connection-close behavior and billing after cancellation are not live-verified.
routes.usage_reporting: Hutch records endpoint-reported tokens; declared token allowance is a proxy, not the vendor's quota counter.
routes.quota_reporting: Provider quota/reset times are not queried. Configured Hutch allowances are operator estimates.
routes.retention: Provider model terms vary; review the plan's current terms before scheduling work.

omitted: automatic paid fallback to another connection

routes.verification: Offline connection/protocol fixtures only; no OpenCode Go credentials or live calls were used.

routes.title: Sign in with ChatGPT token sharing
routes.harness: Hutch builtin runtime; opt-in local public-client sign-in
routes.api_shape: Fixed OpenAI Responses API at https://api.openai.com/v1
routes.auth_flow: Experimental PKCE/OIDC local callback with dynamic registration and chatgpt.tokens.use.direct scope. Disabled unless HUTCH_ENABLE_CHATGPT_PLAN=1. Hutch eligibility remains unconfirmed; no live account was used.
routes.models: Fetched from the official account model-list endpoint when the user opens model selection; only list-visible models are offered. No live catalog was used.
routes.streaming: Required and fixture-tested. Interrupted streams are not replayed; missing usage remains estimated/uncertain.
routes.tool_calls: Hutch function-tool calls are mapped through the normal approval and execution path in recorded fixtures. Hosted MCP and other excluded preview tools are not sent.
routes.structured_output: Unsupported fields must be omitted according to the current preview limitations.
routes.cancellation: Hutch closes the streaming response when stopped. A provider-side outcome may be uncertain and is not replayed.
routes.usage_reporting: Completed Responses usage is recorded. Missing or interrupted usage is estimated and held for reconciliation.
routes.quota_reporting: OpenAI plan allowance/reset data is not queried; Hutch estimates are not provider-enforced caps.
routes.retention: Every request sends store=false. Hutch does not claim this establishes broader account retention behavior.

sent: function tools through additional_tools input items

routes.verification: Local OAuth, signature-verification, account-store, API-route and Responses-body fixtures pass. No OpenAI account, authorization server, or paid provider was used live. Hutch eligibility is unconfirmed.
